title: Headquarters Letterhead and Envelope
slide_intent: Teach designers how a headquarters signature carries across two pieces of correspondence. A recipient should recognize the sender on the envelope and again on the letter.
strategic_value: NASA can distinguish headquarters correspondence with a consistent signature, return address and typographic treatment across the two formats.
demonstration: The page pairs a letterhead with a matching envelope. Red logotypes mark both pieces, while black type identifies the agency and its Washington address.
practical_value: Use the letterhead and envelope together to locate the return address, reply line, postal indicia and mark. The upper notes also describe the alternative warm-gray printing scheme.

content_islands.name: Format and printing guidance
content_islands.spec: Place the heading, paper sizes, type specifications and color instructions across the top.

content_islands.name: Letterhead specimen
content_islands.spec: Place the vertically proportioned letterhead beneath the guidance. Keep the signature block near its upper left, the reply line below it and the writing field open.

content_islands.name: Envelope specimen
content_islands.spec: Align the wide envelope below the letter. Place the sender block at left, the red mark farther right and the postal indicia at the far right.
